response.consequence: The ResizeEmoji job fails with ArgumentError, so emoji resizing stops working. Any other width/height caller of downsize breaks the same way.
response.explanation: Ruby has no overloading. `def self.downsize(from, to, dimensions, opts={})` at line 149 replaces `def self.downsize(from, to, max_width, max_height, opts={})` at line 145. The existing caller in app/jobs/regular/resize_emoji.rb:14 calls `OptimizedImage.downsize(path, path, 100, 100, opts)` with 5 arguments. The remaining method accepts at most 4, so this raises ArgumentError. The new "80%" call in uploads_controller.rb works only because it uses the 4-argument form.
